name: Abe
description: Abes are sweet, delicate flowers. They need to be treated gingerly, with great consideration for their feelings.

name: Ada
description: Adas enjoy writing poetry in their downtime. Dark poetry.

name: Amari
description: Amaris likes to keep the peace. Ironically, they're a riot at parties.

name: Ari
description: Aris tend to space out from time to time, but they always pay attention when it counts.

name: Ashkan
description: Ashkans have what can only be described as a "seriously infectious giggle".

name: Banhi
description: The "cool loner" vibes that radiate off a Banhi never fail to make the colony swoon.

name: Bubbles
description: This Bubbles is constantly challenging others to fight her, regardless of whether or not she can actually take them.

name: Burt
description: This Burt always feels great after a bubble bath and a good long cry.

name: Camille
description: This Camille loves anything that makes her feel nostalgic, including things that haven't aged well.

name: Catalina
description: A Catalina is admired by all for her seemingly tireless work ethic. Little do people know, she's dying on the inside.

name: Chip
description: This Chip is extremely good at guessing their friends' passwords.

name: Devon
description: This Devon dreams of owning their own personal computer so they can start a blog full of pictures of toast.

name: Edwiredo
description: This Edwiredo once rolled his eye so hard that he powered himself off and on again.

name: Ellie
description: Nothing makes an Ellie happier than a big tin of glitter and a pack of unicorn stickers.

name: Frankie
description: There's nothing Frankies are more proud of than their thick, dignified eyebrows.

name: Freyja
description: This Freyja has never stopped anyone from eating yellow snow.

name: Gizmo
description: Gizmos love nothing more than a big juicy info dump.

name: Gossmann
description: Gossmanns are major goofballs who can make anyone laugh.

name: Harold
description: Get a bunch of Harolds together in a room, and you'll have... a bunch of Harolds together in a room.

name: Hassan
description: If someone says something nice to a Hassan he'll think about it nonstop for no less than three weeks.

name: Higby
description: This Higby's got a song in his heart. Now if only he could remember how it goes.

name: Jean
description: Just because Jeans are a little slow doesn't mean they can't suffer from soul-crushing existential crises.

name: Jorge
description: Jorge loves his new colony, even if their collective body odor makes his eyes water.

name: Joshua
description: Joshuas are precious goobers. Other Duplicants are strangely incapable of cursing in a Joshua's presence.

name: Kai
description: The secret to a Kai's perfectly soft hair is marine mineral hair masks.

name: Leira
description: Leiras just want everyone to be happy.

name: Liam
description: No matter how much this Liam scrubs, he can never truly feel clean.

name: Lindsay
description: A Lindsay is a charming woman, unless you make the mistake of messing with one of her friends.

name: Mae
description: There's nothing a Mae can't do if she sets her mind to it.

name: Marie
description: This Marie is positively glowing! What's her secret? Radioactive isotopes, of course.

name: Max
description: At any given moment a Max is viscerally reliving ten different humiliating memories.

name: Maya
description: This Maya got her hand crushed in a pneumatic door once. It was the most alive she's ever felt.

name: Meep
description: Meeps have a face only a two tonne Printing Pod could love.

name: Mi-Ma
description: Ol' Mi-Ma here can't stand lookin' at people's knees.

name: Minnow
description: Minnow always goes with the flow. Unless the flow is going somewhere boring.

name: Nails
description: People often expect a Duplicant named "Nails" to be tough, but they're all pretty huge wimps.

name: Nikola
description: This Nikola once claimed he could build a laser so powerful it would rip the colony in half. No one asked him to prove it.

name: Nisbet
description: This Nisbet likes to punch people to show her affection. Everyone's too afraid of her to tell her it hurts.

name: Otto
description: Ottos always insult people by accident and generally exist in a perpetual state of deep regret.

name: Pei
description: Every Pei spends at least half the day pretending that they remember what they came into this room for.

name: Quinn
description: This Quinn's favorite genre of music is "festive power ballad".

name: Ren
description: Every Ren has this unshakable feeling that his life's already happened and he's just watching it unfold from a memory.

name: Rowan
description: Rowans have exceptionally large hearts and express their emotions most efficiently by yelling.

name: Ruby
description: This Ruby asks the pressing questions, like "Where can I get a leather jacket in space?"

name: Sena
description: Senas only care about three things: gold accents, true crime, and the advancement of nuclear physics.

name: Sonyar
description: Sonyars would sooner burn down the colony than read an instruction manual.

name: Steela
description: Steelas aren't programmed to put up with nonsense, but they do enjoy the occasional shenanigan.

name: Steve
description: This Steve is convinced that he has psychic powers. And he knows exactly what his friends think about that.

name: Stinky
description: This Stinky has never been invited to a party, which is a shame. His dance moves are incredible.

name: Travaldo
description: A Travaldo's monotonous voice and lack of facial expression makes it impossible for others to tell when he's messing with them.

name: Turner
description: This Turner is paralyzed by the knowledge that others have memories and perceptions of them they can't control.

name: Ulti
description: This Ulti's favorite dance move is The Robot. They don't get why others think that's funny.
